newsitem.title: USA: API delays U.S. petroleum report until Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: API delays U.S. petroleum report until Wednesday.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday that it would delay the release of its weekly petroleum stocks data until Wednesday.
An API spokesman said insufficient companies had reported information following Monday's Veteran's Day holiday to produce the report Tuesday as originally planned.
The report should be issued Wednesday after 4.30 p.m. EST (2130 GMT).
The Energy Information Administration said last week it would delay its report by one day this week until 9.00 a.m. EST (1400 GMT) on Thursday.
The American Gas Association expects its weekly underground storage data to be released as usual on Wednesday after 4.00 p.m. (2100 GMT).
